name: barca
description: Cliente FTP, FTPS e SFTP moderno para macOS

scripts.zip: cd dist && rm -f Barca-$npm_package_version-macos-arm64.zip && ditto -c -k --sequesterRsrc --keepParent Barca-darwin-arm64/Barca.app Barca-$npm_package_version-macos-arm64.zip && shasum -a 256 Barca-$npm_package_version-macos-arm64.zip > SHA256SUMS.txt
scripts.dist: npm run package && npm run sign && npm run zip
